text:
maya: Heads up — starting ~10:30 UTC I'm seeing a huge uptick in remote_write errors from eu-west prometheus instances. Lots of 504s and 'write failed' spikes in the logs. Anyone on call?

ben: yep saw it a few mins ago. queue_length on remote_write is climbing, Cortex upstream getting partial write failures.

prometheus-bot: :rotating_light: Alert firing: PrometheusRemoteWriteErrors (eu-west). 65 errors / 5m.

alejandra: i'm looking at the agent relabel configs we pushed in the last deploy. quick grep shows a labelmap rule that might be copying many pod labels into series keys.

samir: i noticed the timeouts are concentrated to eu-west; us-west looks ok. could be network/multi-cluster routing or simply queue saturation upstream.

ben: logs from the prom agent in eu-west (tail):
```
level=error ts=2026-03-17T10:31:12Z caller=remote.go:247 component=remote err="write failed, status=504" backoff=1m0s
level=warn ts=2026-03-17T10:31:13Z caller=queue_manager.go:142 component=remote queue_length=1980
level=error ts=2026-03-17T10:31:14Z caller=queue_manager.go:185 component=remote partial_write=124
```

maya: can you paste the relabel block you think is the culprit?

alejandra: sure — this was added to the agent daemonset by the rollout earlier today: 
```
relabel_configs:
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_commit]
  regex: (.*)
  target_label: commit
  action: replace
- action: labelmap
  regex: __meta_kubernetes_pod_label_(.+)
```
That labelmap is broad — some of our pods have label keys like `feature_flag_` + random id which is producing thousands of dynamic label keys.

ben: ugh. labelmap + unbounded pod labels = cardinality explosion. That will blow up series count and increase remote_write payloads hugely.

samir: so the sequence is: agent scrapes -> relabel creates tons of new series -> remote_write attempts to push, upstream rejects partial writes -> queues back up -> timeouts. matches what we're seeing.

maya: aleja, can you revert the labelmap? If we disable it on the running config we should stop new series creation.

alejandra: i'm on it. rolling back the DS config now, doing a `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/prometheus-agent -n monitoring` in eu-west.

deploy-bot: rollout started for daemonset/prometheus-agent (monitoring) by alejandra — uid: rs-20260317-az2

ben: also recommend pausing remote_write batching growth to reduce immediate pressure: set `max_shards_in_flight` lower and throttle retries for eu-west. But let's get the relabel rollback first.

alejandra: rollback applied and agents are restarting.

prometheus-bot: :white_check_mark: eu-west agents restarted (10 pods). Detected config change: removed labelmap action.

ben: queue_length dropping from 1980 -> 320 in last 3 mins. write error rate falling.

maya: great. can we add a targeted alert suppression so we don't trigger noisy pages for the transient tail? Also we need a follow-up to tighten relabel rules in the prom job templates.

alejandra: opened a followup ticket: INC-3427 (infra) with proposed changes: convert labelmap -> explicit label whitelist, add `action: drop` for known dynamic labels, and patch the daemonset default to limit labelmap scope. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1289

samir: also recommend we add a dashboard panel for `remote_write_queue_length` per-region and a derived metric for `new_series_rate` so we can catch cardinality spikes before they hit remote_write.

ben: +1. and we should tune the alert: only page when errors > 50 for >10m OR queue_length > 1000 for >5m. Right now the alert is too sensitive to short blips.

maya: agreed. i'll create the alert PR and schedule a short postmortem doc.

alejandra: note for postmortem: cause = overly-broad labelmap relabel rule in agent config; contributing = remote_write queue/backpressure and alert thresholds that were too low. mitigation = rollback labelmap, temporary throttle, restart, and later: whitelist labels + alert tuning.

prometheus-bot: :chart_with_upwards_trend: metrics update: remote_write_errors last 5m = 7 (down from 65).

maya: final status — errors largely cleared, queue drains to normal. creating postmortem ticket in backlog and adding owners for the relabel PR and dashboard. thanks for the quick triage team :thumbsup: :eyes:
